code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()  # OPENAI_API_KEY
r = client.responses.create(
    model="MODEL_NAME",
    input=prompt)
print(r.output_text)
caption: Needs a key and network. Confirm current docs.

code:
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic()
m = client.messages.create(
    model="MODEL_NAME",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user",
               "content": prompt}])
print(m.content[0].text)
caption: Key read from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
